categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: Leaching and Smelting. The Leaching segment involves production and sale of copper cathodes, cobalt hydroxide, and sulphur-burning sulphuric acid using solvent extraction-electrowinning technology. The Smelting segment focuses on production and sale of blister copper, copper anodes, sulphuric acid, and liquid sulphur dioxide using ISA smelting technology, including copper product processing services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes solvent extraction-electrowinning technology for leaching operations to produce copper cathodes and cobalt hydroxide. For smelting operations, it employs ISA smelting technology to produce blister copper, copper anodes, and by-products such as sulphuric acid and liquid sulphur dioxide. The company also emphasizes process optimization and technical transformation to improve cobalt processing capacity and ore recovery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves industrial customers primarily in the copper and cobalt sectors, with major sales destinations including Mainland China, Switzerland, Singapore, Hong Kong, Africa, and Luxembourg. Key customers include large industrial buyers with individual customers accounting for over 10% of total revenue. The company also provides copper product processing services to external enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly located in Zambia and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with principal business offices in Hong Kong, Zambia (Kitwe), and the DRC (Lubumbashi). Revenue is generated globally, with significant sales to Mainland China, Switzerland, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Africa.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates vertically integrated mining and processing activities, covering upstream mining, midstream ore processing and leaching, and downstream smelting and refining. It controls the entire supply chain from exploration, mining, ore processing, smelting to sales of refined copper and cobalt products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include increasing output, cost control, strengthening management, expanding copper and cobalt reserves through exploration and resource acquisition, and enhancing sustainable development. The company focuses on process improvement, technical research, and scientific innovation to improve efficiency and product quality. It also emphasizes compliance risk control and corporate governance enhancement.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through sales of copper products including blister copper, copper anodes, copper cathodes, cobalt hydroxide, sulphuric acid, and liquid sulphur dioxide. The company also earns processing fees from copper product processing services provided to external enterprises.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading, fast-growing, and vertically integrated copper producer with global competitiveness, focusing on Central and Southern Africa. It competes in the nonferrous metals mining and smelting industry, with competitors likely including other major copper mining and smelting companies operating in Africa and globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company reported revenue of approximately US$4.1 billion, a slight increase from 2021, with net profit attributable to owners of US$264 million, reflecting a 26% decrease year-on-year. The company has a total asset base of about US$4 billion and equity attributable to owners of approximately US$1.66 billion. Production volumes showed growth in copper cathodes and cobalt, while blister copper production slightly declined. The company maintains a net cash position and has been investing in mining and processing facilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its vertically integrated operations, combining mining, ore processing, leaching, and smelting to provide stable and quality copper and cobalt products. It leverages advanced technologies such as solvent extraction-electrowinning and ISA smelting, along with continuous process optimization and innovation, to enhance product quality and operational efficiency. The company also focuses on sustainable development, environmental protection, and strong corporate governance to create long-term value for shareholders and stakeholders.
